title: Ignore a hermetic forbidden home when Windows spells it with a verbatim disk prefix
goal: A SUSI_HOME from canonicalize (\\?\C:\...) must still be ignored when SUSI_HERMETIC_FORBIDDEN is the same directory in plain spelling, so hermetic tests do not write into the forbidden root.

partial_evidence.note: hermetic_forbidden passed on Linux, but canonicalize yields no verbatim disk-prefix spelling there, so the Windows comparison was unexercised (CLAUDE, review of intellibitz/susi#1668)
